_comment: One entry per company/practice. frontInboxId and xeroTenantId are identifiers, not secrets. status: off = never touched; dry_run = may be scanned and dry-run (reads only), never written to or scheduled; live = included in the daily schedule and execute runs. A company that is not off must have its Xero tenant ID and name. payBank: metro = included in the ONE consolidated Metro pay run file (each line paid from that company's own account, set in the PAY_RUN_DEBIT_ACCOUNTS Railway variable); revolut = its own separate Revolut file (AVL); omitted = no pay run file. Each Front inbox may only ever write to its own Xero organisation; xeroTenantName must match the organisation name Xero reports exactly. VAT treatment for each inbox is set in coding-policies.json.
